decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed contained many items that were camping accessories rather than actual backpacks. From the true backpacks available, I selected five with high ratings and specific use cases (sling, cooler, fishing, hydration). I chose the N NEVO RHINO Sling Backpack (prod_backpacks_182) as the final purchase because it has a very high rating (4.6) across over 1,000 reviews, indicating consistent quality and customer satisfaction for a versatile daily-use bag at a reasonable price. This maintains the current purchase rate near the 70% target for this simulation.
